reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual comparison of the exact 65x67 source PNG, enlarged existing source-page 12 and targeted source-note crop, complete unchanged 2048x2048 raw RGBA and native note/right-edge crop, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and evidence, and unchanged naiwa.png; checked the corrected lower-mouth/chin beard boundary, brown hair, rectangular spectacles, suit/green tie, pose, collar, frame/backplate and the original two-row note and right tab.

remaining_reasons: The enlarged original note has TWO compact upper gray-mark rows. The returned native note replaces them with ONE row of rounded dots and omits the second source row. Restore the original two-row upper footprint and spacing without inventing dot glyphs or adding extra writing.

The source's small dark right-edge note tab is not retained on the returned note's right edge. Restore that original compact tab and edge construction rather than leaving a plain worn edge or adding different hardware.
entries.positive_observation: The prior beard problem is corrected: the pale moustache and white beard remain concentrated around the lower mouth and chin, while the upper cheeks between the spectacle rims and beard are smooth yellow without a broad cheek/temple beard. Brown side-parted hair, narrow sideburns, separate dark brows and dark rectangular spectacles remain, with one stern closed mouth. The slight left three-quarter pose, crop and soft directional modeling remain. The dark charcoal-brown suit, light pointed shirt collar and dark green tie remain without added decorations; the rounded chin/beard meets a short broad fitted collar without a stalk or pinching. The complete dark frame and opaque dark charcoal/blue-grey backplate remain. Full white/cyan comparisons show no visible interior holes, lost backing or working-matte ring. These positive features do not offset the clear note-row and tab losses above.
entries.visible_limitations: Individual beard hairs, fine spectacle rims and note lettering are not readable at 65x67 and are not rejection grounds. The rejection is based on clearly resolved two-source-rows versus one returned dot row and the absent right-edge tab in enlarged source/native-return comparisons.
